```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-comparison
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Model Comparison Against the Manually Coded Sample: Cohen's $\\kappa$ per Variable"

files <- list.files("data/comments",
                    pattern = "^eval_report_coding_v\\d+\\.xlsx$",
                    full.names = TRUE)

reports <- purrr::map_dfr(files, \(f) {
  readxl::read_excel(f) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Run = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(basename(f), "(?<=_v)\\d+")))
})

var_labels <- c(pers_exp = "Personal Exp.", emot_exp = "Emotional Expr.",
                pol_opin = "Political Op.", breadth = "Breadth",
                valence = "Valence", contr = "Controversy")

per_run <- reports |>
  dplyr::distinct(Run, model, variable, n, cohens_kappa, krippendorff_alpha) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Run, model) |>
  dplyr::mutate(`Valid n` = min(n),
                `Mean $\\alpha$` = mean(krippendorff_alpha)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

comp <- per_run |>
  dplyr::mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = names(var_labels),
                                  labels = var_labels)) |>
  dplyr::select(Run, Model = model, `Valid n`, `Mean $\\alpha$`, variable, cohens_kappa) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = cohens_kappa) |>
  dplyr::mutate(`Mean $\\kappa$` = rowMeans(dplyr::pick(dplyr::all_of(unname(var_labels))))) |>
  dplyr::relocate(`Mean $\\alpha$`, .after = dplyr::last_col()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Run)

knitr::kable(comp, digits = 2, escape = FALSE,
             align = c("r", "l", "r", rep("r", 8)))
```

*Note.* Run = evaluation report number, in chronological order. Valid n = number of the 150 manually coded comments for which the model returned a usable label (minimum across variables). Run 11 is the final model used in the analyses.
